title: Claims Manual, Harbison Protection Contracts: The No-Lemon Unit Replacement
content:
### 1. When the unit is replaced

On a Harbison Protection Contracts tier that carries the unit replacement guarantee, an approved compressor or heat exchanger claim that brings the unit's approved compressor and heat exchanger failures within the tier's no-lemon window years of the coverage start to the tier's qualifying failure count is settled by replacing the unit instead of repairing it again. The count is read from the unit's claim history: claims on that unit for a compressor or heat exchanger whose decision approved or partially approved them, against the contract's coverage start.

### 2. What is paid

The replacement is paid as a unit replacement payout of the cost of an equivalent unit installed by Harbison, up to the tier's replacement cap and never beyond the contract's remaining claim benefit, credited to the replacement installation contract the homeowner signs for it. The claim pays no repair lines on that visit beyond the diagnostic fee and the after-hours premium the tier covers.

### 3. Limits of the guarantee

The replacement is offered only when the qualifying count is reached. A failure of any other component never counts, and a failure after the window is repaired normally.

### 4. After the replacement

The replacement equipment receives a new included workmanship warranty through its installation, while this contract stays in force on the replaced unit's record until it expires.

**Decision table (hypothetical, using a qualifying count of 2 within a 5-year window).**

| Approved failure being decided | Earlier approved compressor or heat exchanger failures on the unit within the window | Settlement |
|---|---|---|
| compressor, year 3 | one heat exchanger failure, year 1 | count reaches 2: unit replaced |
| heat exchanger, year 2 | none | count is 1: repaired |
| blower motor, year 4 | two compressor failures | never counts: repaired |
| compressor, year 6 | one compressor failure, year 2 | after the window: repaired normally |
